overall_assessment: The Searchright licensed adapter architecture rigorously respects intellectual property boundaries, vendor API terms of use, and institutional licensing constraints. The codebase strictly prohibits HTML scraping, avoids bundled access credentials, and disables default live execution. It enforces zero persistence of raw proprietary response payloads by default, operating exclusively as a query planning and protocol integration adapter.

findings.description: The adapter contract explicitly forbids automated scraping and CAPTCHA evasion, aligning with research institution licensing agreements.
findings.recommendation: Retain explicit terms acknowledgments during future live user onboarding.

findings.description: BYO access policies require the user to hold valid institutional credentials, preventing unauthorised redistribution or proxy evasion.
findings.recommendation: Ensure user documentation highlights individual institutional policy compliance.

findings.description: Clear claim boundaries are maintained: synthetic fixture validation is not represented as active vendor licensing endorsements.
findings.recommendation: Preserve these boundaries in all external scientific communications.

calibration_notes: Legal and compliance reviewers confirm that the adapter framework introduces zero copyright or terms-of-service infringement risk.
